extraction.notes: Whole readout read. The meeting agenda lists freedom of movement for workers, but the readout reports no discussion of, or claim about, Chapter 2; no chapter-basis items. Theme items come from the digital transformation and media paragraph. Left out as not material or out of scope: education, Erasmus+, youth, culture, audiovisual media agency funding, social policy and employment, gender-disaggregated data (incidental: statistics without data systems), research and innovation data for the European Innovation Scoreboard (incidental), Smart Specialisation Strategy and INOVA (no digital content stated), and the Commission's statement of support. cluster and chapter left empty for theme items: the readout gives no chapter numbers and the material is not Chapter 2. Speaker recorded as 'the Commission' as printed; the meeting year is not stated in the text, so event_date is left empty. Revised under rules 0.2 and themes 1.1 on 29 October 2026: two items retyped as interventions (R11), one theme_doubtful flag resolved, eu_scale.applies_to added (null throughout); no items removed or added.
